## Analysis
Only one attempt exists, so no cross-run pattern is established. It validates the evaluator path and gives a feasible baseline, but the 17-element, span-29 seed reaches only 1.059793—well below the stated 1.144887 reference—so “official SimpleTES seed” is evidently an initializer, not the reference construction. No mutation strategy, larger cardinality, or wider span has yet been tested; thus none is refuted. Since scoring uses exact cardinalities and ignores reported metrics, search should optimize recomputed C directly while preserving the best set continuously.
